q: How do I calculate CBAM embedded emissions when I buy the same steel input from two suppliers?
title: One precursor from two suppliers
short: Use each supplier's embedded emissions per tonne for the tonnes you actually consumed in the period. If you cannot trace which coil went into which product, weight the two figures by tonnes consumed. Any tonnes without supplier data take the default value.
audience: Tube, wire and fastener makers buying coil or rod from more than one mill

ol: Tonnes consumed from each supplier, from issue or stock records.
Each supplier's embedded emissions per tonne for the same period.
Weighted figure = sum of tonnes × factor ÷ total tonnes.
Use the default value for any tonnes without supplier data.

p: Record the supplier, heat or coil numbers and the period of each figure. A verifier will check that the tonnes match your purchase and stock records.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and purchase invoices into dated, fingerprinted installation records, the starting point for the actual emissions an EU importer asks for. It does not file CBAM declarations or verify emissions.

sources.label: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2023/1773, production routes and monitoring

example.title: Example: coil from two mills
lines: 2,160 ÷ 1,000 = 2.16 t CO2 per tonne of coil
